answer: Sybil resistance arises because bonded escrows aggregate evidence across identities: when k coordinated agents equivocate on the same consensus signal, correlated penalties grow as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection then applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling stake, rapidly exhausting collateral through asymmetric depreciation. Thus identities labeled comet or vertex cannot cheaply conceal coordination or recycle slashed funds.
